query: SELECT m.id, m.name, m.radar_intensity, m.radar_freshness, m.radar_warmth, m.radar_sweetness, m.radar_spiciness, m.radar_earthiness FROM molecules m INNER JOIN molecules_recettes mr ON m.id = mr.molecule_id INNER JOIN recettes r ON mr.recette_id = r.id WHERE r.category = 'resine_cbd' LIMIT 10;
